scope: Recorded ViT-L/14 validation and selected B/16 scale/budget experiments; not the full project lifetime cost.

definitions.accounted_wall_seconds: Per stage: prefer outer pipeline process wall; otherwise use explicitly labelled internal stage wall. Never sum both.
definitions.gpu_stage_wall_hours_proxy: Single-GPU stage wall / 3600, including CPU, loading, synchronization and I/O. Not GPU kernel utilization hours, exclusive allocation, or billed hours.
definitions.hardware_context: Shared server. Per-stage GPU names are retained; these timings are affected by shared CPU/I/O and are not hardware-normalized comparisons.
definitions.missing: Null means not recorded or not yet complete, never zero. Totals sum known completed records only.
definitions.training_runs: Non-additive breakdown, including separate small/full coverage runs at Pets49. Already included in parent stages.
definitions.evaluation: Cached-prefix research evaluation can reuse image-only outputs across tasks. These costs must not be interpreted as deployment latency.
definitions.excluded: Earlier pilots except reused teacher source, downloads, transfers, archival, plotting, audits and latency benchmark execution are outside this selected cost ledger.
